item.content:
The challenger

And there he was, a student looking down, quietly screaming with a cry. “Why can’t I do it? I am so weak. I commit the same mistakes, over and over again. I know them. I know them too well! And yet! I can’t. I can’t leave this endless loop of misery.”

The master looked back, with serious expression. Suddenly, he burst into a loud laugh. Just as fast as that laugh came in, it went away and was replaced by an even more serious face. He could see his eyes casting a shadow.

As he noticed that, he also saw the hands of the master going to his waist. Before he understood what was happening, he heard a loud BANG.

He felt his ear ringing, and his heart pumping blood, rushing through his body as fast as ever, as if looking for an exit that thankfully isn’t there.

The master was holding a smoking Beretta. “If I had trembled just slightly, your story would have ended now,” he said with anger. No, it wasn’t anger, his seriousness and wrinkles went so deep that it looked like anger. His smile was turned down and you could feel a deep black shadow covering his face.

“Ya ain’t got no time to doubt or to think about any of that. If there’s something you want to do, do it now or as soon as possible. God won’t give you more pages than he let you have.”

The student felt every word vibrating his body, still in shock. “Give all your will, thoughts, body, mind, heart, pain and love into staying sharp. If you don’t keep sharp, you will never be able to hit hard and fast, and you’ll never surpass me.”

His serious, somber shadow turned into a defying, vigorous smile. “You know what’s right and wrong. Pray to keep that judgment, because that’s where your strength lies, which can only shine through sharpness.”

The student noticed he couldn’t find his previous thoughts, they were vanished. What was he even thinking before?

“Trust in your peers, those who’ve walked near you, pay attention to them more than to the rest of the world. Their truth will turn into realizations burned into your judgment. If you keep what I said close, you are ready, right now.”

In the place of his thoughts only remained his fixated, lit eyes.

item.title: whoareyou
item.author: stelin41.crypto@gmail.com (stelin41)
item.description:
Who are you?

Think carefully and read slowly. Really, stop. Read slow enough to understand the full meaning of each individual word.

Now, in your mind ask yourself: who are you?

Your name? No, that’s not you. Your hobbies? No. Your job? Neither. Everything you do? Closer, but that’s not you. Everything you did? Getting hotter, but that’s still not you. Everything you think or thought? Interesting, but you aren’t that.
item.content:
Who are you?

Think carefully and read slowly. Really, stop. Read slow enough to understand the full meaning of each individual word.

Now, in your mind ask yourself: who are you?

Your name? No, that’s not you. Your hobbies? No. Your job? Neither. Everything you do? Closer, but that’s not you. Everything you did? Getting hotter, but that’s still not you. Everything you think or thought? Interesting, but you aren’t that.

Did you ran out of ideas?

Then, who are you?

A story

You are your story. That is not necessarily what you did or saw, but what you observed. Every time you notice something, you are building your story.

We live by, and for stories. We live our story while hearing, reading and witnessing other real and fictional stories. Sometimes we disbelief real stories, and believe in fictional stories.

Real stories are those that were observed by someone, even if they observed the wrong thing. Fictional stories are made up for us to learn, to remember, to know what to observe, to dream about our story.

Stories are what move us forward, what makes you want to walk faster, speak louder. They are also what makes you want to grind your teeth or lay down the whole day. They are what makes you want to fight for something, for someone, or flee. However, you must remember: your story is what you observe. Anything you see or hear, any action that you take and don’t observe, is not written in your story.

Other people will have a different story about themselves and about you. Everything you do, every choice you make, was grown on top of your story and the stories you know.

If you can’t find answers to your questions, if you are stuck running in circles, if you lack resolve in your decisions, keep building your story. Try to observe yourself and the world around you more. Therefore, if you can’t answer my question, that is why: Attention Is All You Need.
